item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod kyi rgyud las dgra chos myur mgyogs glog gi zhags pa
item.coloph: ces dgra chos myur mgyog(mgyogs) glog gi zhags pa bya ba 'di yang / don gnyer rdo dza'i (dzas) bskul ngor/ 'phags spu a yu un bdag gi(gis) dmar ser can zhes me mo sbrul gyi zla tshes la smin grol gsang ba'i khrod du 'od ldan yum gyi lung bzhin babs pa'o//
